findings: The current lesson is a short generic introduction with no source references and objectives that cannot establish complete exodontia assessment coverage.

Prepare observable bounded outcomes and obtain topic-specific references and independent review before any teaching release.

issues_before_approval: IDA page publication/revision year is not displayed; do not invent one or treat accreditation material as exhaustive current law.

Candidate v0.2 contains disease-specific screening and procedural topics without exact topic-specific evidence; this audit does not clear them.
Do not generalize VKA INR thresholds to DOACs, medication interruption to all regimens, or a pressure interval to uncontrolled bleeding.
MCQ single-best-answer validity, distractor/rationale quality, ambiguity and case-specific escalation remain unapproved.
No licensed textbook chapter/page, independent reviewer, signed clinical release or approved clinical illustration is supplied.
Fresh/application/delayed retention items and educational completeness require separate preparation and review.
